content_sections.heading: About C.M.P. Degree College
content_sections.text: C.M.P. Degree College (Chaudhary Mahadev Prasad Mahavidyalaya) is a Constituent P.G. College of the University of Allahabad, located at Mahatma Gandhi Marg, George Town, Prayagraj-211002, Uttar Pradesh. Its letterhead describes it as NAAC Accredited B++. The Assistant Professor posts are advertised in various subjects in the college, keeping in view the broad areas of specialization in each subject.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 33 Assistant Professor posts across 14 subjects, with the category-wise and PwBD break-up below. The college reserves the right to change the number and nature of posts of any category, or not to fill any of the posts. # Music: one post in Music-Vocal and one post in Music Instrumental-Tabla. The PwBD categories used in the table are: Category (a): Blindness and low vision Category (b): Deaf and hard of hearing Category (c): Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy Category (d): Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness Category (e): Multiple disabilities from among persons under clauses (a) to (d), including deaf-blindness

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants should possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as of the closing date of application. The posts are advertised keeping in view the broad areas of specialization in subjects; the concerned department may have specific requirements for specialization. Applicants for the post of Assistant Professor must submit a certificate in the prescribed format from the concerned University that their Ph.D. degree is in compliance with the relevant UGC Regulations for the award of Ph.D. degree. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Reservation for SC, ST, EWS, OBC (non-creamy layer) and PwBD applicants applies as per UGC/Central Government norms and Government of India rules. Category certificates must be uploaded in the format prescribed by the Union Government and should be digitally verifiable. OBC applicants must upload an OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate of the current financial year issued by the Competent Authority, and must belong to castes in the Central List for OBCs. For PwBD benefits, the relevant disability should not be less than 40%, with a valid disability certificate uploaded with the application. If the certificates for the reserved category are not uploaded, the application may be rejected, and no appeal will be entertained. Candidates should check the official notification and the UGC Regulations, 2018 for the discipline-specific eligibility of each subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All the advertised Assistant Professor posts carry a rationalized entry pay of Rs 57700/- in the academic level 10 of the pay matrix, 7 CPC, with other admissible allowances as per UGC pay norms. The notice does not mention the tenure or the nature of the appointment. Selected candidates will have to undergo a medical examination as the college may require.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only, followed by a hard copy sent by Speed Post. The steps given in the notice are: Fill the application form on the Recruitment portal of the college website www.cmpcollege.ac.in in the prescribed format, with complete, correct information and attachments. Upload the certificates needed for any reservation claim (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD). Pay the fee online through credit/debit card/Net Banking/UPI, etc. (fee payment starts on 17 November 2026). Complete online registration and final submission of the form by 8 December 2026. Send a printed copy of the successfully submitted online form, with self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates, by Speed Post only, to reach on or before 15 December 2026. Address the envelope to: The Principal, C.M.P. Degree College, M.G. Marg, George Town, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh – 211002. Superscribe the envelope: "Application for the Post of Assistant Professor in [Subject]" vide Advt no: CMP/Rec./01/Asst. Prof./2026. Applicants for more than one subject must apply separately and pay fees separately. Persistent technical issues can be mailed to [email protected] . Fees are paid online only and will not be refunded under any circumstances, including when a candidate is found ineligible. Applications without the requisite fees will be rejected. Printed copy of the successfully submitted online application form (sent by Speed Post) Self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD claims, in the Union Government format and digitally verifiable OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate of the current financial year Valid disability certificate (disability not less than 40%) for PwBD claims Certificate from the concerned University that the Ph.D. degree complies with the relevant UGC Regulations Recent copy of the NOC, for candidates employed by Govt./Private Universities/Colleges/Autonomous bodies

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates should report with all testimonials/certificates in original and a valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License/Passport). A set of self-attested photocopies of certificates on qualifications, experience and category, as indicated in the online form, must be submitted at the interview. Employed candidates must produce the original NOC from their organisation at the interview, with a certificate that (i) no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against them and (ii) they will be relieved within the stipulated time if selected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interviews. Consequential vacancies arising at the time of the interview may also be filled by the available shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are in CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 33 Assistant Professor posts in 14 subjects: UR 17, EWS 1, OBC 8, SC 6 and ST 1, with Commerce and Zoology having 5 posts each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and final submission is 8 December 2026, and the printed copy must reach the college by Speed Post on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per the UGC Regulations, 2018 or as amended up to the date of advertisement, held as of the closing date; applicants must also submit a University certificate that their Ph.D. complies with UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The posts carry a rationalized entry pay of Rs 57700/- in academic level 10 of the pay matrix, 7 CPC, with other admissible allowances as per UGC pay norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total fee is Rs 2500/- for UR, EWS and OBC, Rs 1500/- for SC/ST and Rs 500/- for PwBDs, paid online only and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q6. I applied under the 2022 advertisement. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who applied against Advertisement No. CMP/Rec./Asst.Prof./01/2022 dated 27/09/2022 must apply afresh and pay only the Rs 500/- registration/processing fee, or their candidature will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply on the Recruitment portal of www.cmpcollege.ac.in, then send the printed form with self-attested documents by Speed Post only to The Principal, C.M.P. Degree College, M.G. Marg, George Town, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh – 211002.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Applications are screened as per UGC Regulations 2018 and University of Allahabad Ordinances to shortlist candidates, who are then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for Assistant Professor in more than one subject?
faq.answer: Yes, but applicants for more than one post must apply separately and pay the fees separately.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the CMP Degree College interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending interviews.
